casual1.scene: In the fenced courtyard beside a bathhouse, a small Psyduck rests on a low bench beside her at waist height. A plaster garden wall supports her back; afternoon light catches water droplets on the grass.
casual1.outfit: The striped cotton wrap dress is securely tied across the chest and hips, with an open back above the wrapped waist and a narrow side opening showing the waist. Its stripes are terracotta and cream.
casual1.custom: Small blue feather earrings are the only personal motif; the Psyduck is a separate natural companion.
